$comment: Hard marginal gzip budgets in KiB for splitting-aware production ESM. Each route adds one anchored component to the representative application shell in $baseline; only the entry and its transitively static chunks count as initial, while dynamic first-open chunks remain in the separate total-cost budgets. Ceilings resolve to positive whole-byte limits and retain at most 4% drift. The 2026-09-16 review remeasured the menu route after the current shared slot-collection and menu-item compatibility surfaces were present: it measured 10,272 initial gzip bytes, so its reviewed ceiling is 10,478 bytes (2% headroom). The 2026-09-17 review remeasured the combobox route after its new sync property: it measured 29,850 initial gzip bytes, so its reviewed ceiling is 30,447 bytes (2% headroom). Other ceilings retain their previously reviewed measurements.
